<!-- Notes for the next release, in plain English. The release workflow puts this file at the top
of the draft release, above GitHub's list of merged PRs. After publishing, empty everything below
this comment for the release after. -->

## What's new

- **Say punctuation out loud.** "Comma", "semicolon", "full stop", "question mark" and "exclamation point" now type the mark, not the word: "Hi comma Sarah" types "Hi, Sarah". "Add a comma" and "literal comma" keep the word. "Period" stays a word, since it's too common to guess. Turn it off with `spoken_commands`, along with "new line".
